hits.about: Uniestate Millennium Tower is a residential complex by developer Uniestate Properties, located in the high-tech neighborhood of Dubai Silicon Oasis. The unique modern architecture of the building is formed by open balconies and loggias.All apartments of Uniestate Millennium Tower have a carefully thought-out layout. The interior decoration of the building is made exclusively with high quality materials and elements. Large panoramic windows provide maximum natural light throughout the daylight hours and allow you to admire the picturesque views of the area. Light brown interior finishes create a cozy atmosphere, and central air conditioning provides optimal temperature for comfortable living.For the convenience of residents, the Uniestate Millennium Tower complex houses a well-equipped gym and swimming pool. Security in the building and surrounding areas is ensured by 24-hour video surveillance.Uniestate Millennium Tower's location in the well-developed Dubai Silicon Oasis will provide easy access to the area's prime locations such as schools, shopping centers, recreational areas and parks. Equally close to Dubai's main roads Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Road and Dubai - Al Ain Road will allow quick access to the city's main attractions. Dubai International Airport can be reached in 20 minutes and Sharjah International Airport in 35 minutes.
hits.title: Uniestate Millennium Tower
